department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: Research-focused SM/PhD in CEE, including materials, structures and geomechanics; all admitted SM/PhD students receive research assistantships or fellowships covering tuition, health insurance and a monthly stipend. The MIT doctoral RA base rate is $51,226 for 12 months.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Materials, Structures and Geomechanics

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in CEE with a Structural Engineering & Geomechanics focus; all PhD students in good standing are funded through thesis submission at least at the 20-hour RA salary plus tuition and Cardinal Care health insurance, via fellowships, RAs or teaching assistantships.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Structural Engineering and Geomechanics

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: Doctoral programme in CEE with a Structural Engineering, Mechanics & Materials first preference (structural design, analysis, mechanics and materials); PhD applicants must list faculty in their research programme, and GSI/GSR appointments are awarded with admission.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Structural Engineering, Mechanics and Materials (SEMM)

department: Department of Mechanical and Civil Engineering
summary: Research-oriented PhD in Civil Engineering in the Department of Mechanical and Civil Engineering; all PhD students are offered financial support covering full tuition and fees plus a stipend, as fellowships, research or teaching assistantships. The PhD stipend rate is $50,000 for 12 months from 1 September 2026.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering at Michigan CEE; all incoming PhD students are offered full financial support including a stipend, full tuition and health and dental benefits, as a departmental fellowship, graduate student research assistantship, instructorship or external fellowship.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering with a Structural Engineering area (structural analysis, dynamics, mechanics, concrete and steel structures); the department's stated deadline for fall applicants seeking financial aid is 1 December, with admission requiring a faculty research advisor.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering — Structural Engineering

department: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in the School of Civil and Environmental Engineering; nearly all funding is as a graduate research or teaching assistantship (20 hours/week) with a monthly stipend and a waiver of most tuition. The PhD GRA rate stated by the school is $2,835 per month ($34,020 per year).
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering

department: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: Fully supported Graduate Research Assistant positions in the Robotics & Intelligent Construction Automation Lab (Prof. Yong-Kwon Cho) for a PhD in Civil Engineering focused on construction engineering — data sensing, 3D LADAR control for robotic construction, rapid 3D built-environment modelling, BIM and UAVs — on NSF, State DOT, TRB and industry projects.
title: PhD Graduate Research Assistant — Robotics and Intelligent Construction Automation (RICAL)

department: Fariborz Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering with a Structural Engineering emphasis in the Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering; fall/summer applications are due 1 December, and applicants select a specific research area, with funding through research and teaching assistantships.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering — Structural Engineering

department: Fariborz Maseeh Department of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering
summary: One funded PhD (or MS) graduate student to join the COMPOUND Flood Lab (Assistant Professor Jun-Whan Lee) in Fall 2027, working on compound flooding, debris-structure-wave interactions and flood risk assessment using numerical modelling, machine learning and remote sensing, supported by a research and/or teaching assistantship.
title: PhD Graduate Student — Compound Flooding, Debris-Structure-Wave Interactions and Flood Risk (COMPOUND Flood Lab)

department: School of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering, Structural Engineering concentration, covering computational and probabilistic mechanics, structural health monitoring, earthquake engineering, fracture mechanics and civil infrastructure systems; PhD students commonly hold graduate research or teaching assistantships including tuition, stipend and health insurance.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Structural Engineering

department: Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering in the Lyles School of Civil and Construction Engineering; there is no separate funding application, and only highly competitive PhD students recommended for admission are typically offered funding (about 25%), decided by faculty with available positions. Review for August admission begins 1 December, and application materials are accepted until 15 May for fall consideration.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering

department: Department of Civil Engineering and Engineering Mechanics
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering and Engineering Mechanics, covering structural dynamics, structural health and monitoring, fatigue and fracture mechanics and multiscale science and engineering; sponsored doctoral students have tuition and medical insurance covered by the department, with research in structures, materials and geomechanics.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering and Engineering Mechanics

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering with a Mechanics, Materials, and Structures track (also Sustainable, Resilient Cities and Infrastructure Systems); every admitted PhD student receives financial support as a first-year fellowship, continuing as a teaching or research assistantship, plus a stipend and summer research support.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Mechanics, Materials, and Structures

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering in CEE, with Structures (including structural/earthquake engineering and structural mechanics) as a field of study, alongside civil engineering materials and geotechnical engineering; graduate funding is through fellowships, research and teaching assistantships, and applications after 15 December cannot be considered for financial aid.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering — Structures

department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering, with focus areas in Advanced Infrastructure Systems and in Mechanics, Materials, and Computing; many doctoral students receive research assistantships covering tuition, technology fees and a living stipend for the calendar year for up to five years.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering

department: Charles E. Via, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering, including Structural Engineering and Materials, Geotechnical Engineering and Civil Infrastructure Engineering; financial aid is available through assistantships and fellowships and all applicants are reviewed for possible funding. No CEE-specific application deadline was stated on the verified department page.
title: PhD in Civil and Environmental Engineering — Structural Engineering and Materials

department: Zachry Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: PhD in Civil Engineering in the Zachry Department, offering fully supported four-year doctoral fellowships (tuition, fees, stipend and professional development) and teaching/research assistantships, usually $2,000 per month plus tuition and health benefits. To be eligible for all assistantships and fellowships for fall entry, apply by 15 March; international-student I-20 document deadlines also apply.
title: PhD in Civil Engineering
